q1_issues.issue: The adjective's PP complement is emitted as a free-standing kind-to-kind atom (To writer criticism), severing "to criticism" from the sensitive property so nothing records that the sensitivity is TO criticism.
That atom is asserted at (STV 1.0 0.99) although the sentence quantifies only "most" writers, over-committing relative to the 0.9 strength carried by the Inheritance atom it is meant to modify.

q2_gaps: Adjective with a prepositional complement ("sensitive to criticism", "afraid of X", "aware of Y") — the instruction set defines preposition-named obliques only on an event witness (and the entity-attached "from" of origin), and gives no way to attach an adjective's PP argument to a Member/Inheritance property atom.

A preposition-named oblique whose arguments are both bare kinds — the oblique rules assume an event (or entity) in the first slot; kind-to-kind relations are defined only for the lemmatized-verb relational generic (Carry mosquito malaria).
notes: The quantified copular half is exactly right: bare plural + "most" -> (Inheritance writer sensitive) (STV 0.9 0.9) with its QuantifierPhrase companion. The head To is preposition-derived so it is not an invented head, but its (kind, kind) argument position is undefined by the instruction set.
